content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
The TV static spelled words last night. I’m pretty sure it said my name.
I can’t verify messages from static. What exactly did you see—letter shapes, duration, channel, volume level?
Letter shapes for a few seconds on an unused channel, low volume.
Noting channel number, time, and a short phone video could show whether similar shapes recur.
Irregular events can still be logged. If you capture several nights, you can compare how often recognizably letter-like frames appear versus random noise.
Keeping settings constant for a few sessions helps; later, a single change at a time—like input source—can test whether the shapes depend on the setup.
Alright, I’ll record the next instances with the same settings.
